''See also: [[Rhalia Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Rhalia is a guide to the [[City of Light]] who possesses the ability to fly and hover at various heights. Characterized by her golden hair and eyes, she typically wears a white dress that moves as if caught in a breeze. While she lacks combat abilities, she can perform various magical tricks and manipulate objects, such as creating beds of light to lift people or manifesting golden orbs. Her role involves testing travelers to ensure they possess necessary virtues like patience and temperance before they are deemed ready for their journey. Rhalia's history is complex; she was once an [[Incarnation]], a being that embodies the nature and power of a [[Territory]], but she has since transitioned into a more limited state. She previously bound herself within the territory of [[Elysia]] by opening a Gate to avoid a living death. Though she is often cheerful and bright, she has experienced moments of deep sadness and regret regarding her past failures and the Fate{{!}}fate of her people.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Journey through Elysia}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Rhalia serves as [[Alin]]'s guide to the [[City of Light]] while leading him through [[Elysia]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c11">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c13">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 13</ref> During their journey, she explains that handling certain powers necessitates the possession of specific virtues.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c13" /> She also provides a warning that attempting to control power will ultimately result in the power controlling the individual.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c22">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 22</ref> Additionally, Rhalia has previously offered [[Alin]] descriptions of silver light.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c24">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 24</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[Rhalia]] is guiding [[Alin]] through [[Elysia]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c13" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[Rhalia]] explains that certain powers require specific virtues to handle.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c13" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The City of Light}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Rhalia, a former [[Incarnation]] and [[Traveler]], once advised [[Alin]] to utilize the [[Silver Light]] but remained silent at another time.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c7">''City of Light'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c10">''City of Light'', chapter 10</ref> Now existing as a ghost and a [[Traveler]], she appears with golden hair while positioned in a Gate beside [[Alin]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c15">''City of Light'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c26">''City of Light'', chapter 26</ref> From within his Gate, she whispered advice to [[Alin]] and observed that five [[Incarnations]] possessed the power to bring down the walls of [[Elysia]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c26" /> She possesses a white-robed form and a sister dressed in red, often drifting next to [[Alin]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27">''City of Light'', chapter 27</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c28">''City of Light'', chapter 28</ref>}}
